items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Neely; the name 'Neely' is only mentioned by the interviewer in a turn where the interviewee responds about a clarinet, showing no personal connection to Neely.

ctx.x: No, it's not an animal hair. An animal hair would be short. Yeah, that's right. You know what I'm saying? But if it's a hair, you can grab it a handful like that and you wouldn't have a pound. You see, the heavier than those mattresses, you take for instance, like a 40 or 45 pounds of that hair, eating that, and you look at it, you'd say, oh man, that's too much. How are you going to handle that? You understand? It's puffed up like that. That's the whole mattress. You understand? You know what I'm saying? Because…
Yeah. Yeah. Well, Neely, we brought some clarinets down here to show you. Ralph's got a 13p. Here's just a part of one. Did you ever see one like that? Made out of light colored wood?
Well, this is a Chinese instrument.
